chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasani, from Abu Ayyub al-Madani, the freedman of the Banu Hashim, from Dawud ibn Abdullah ibn Muhammad al-Ja'fari, from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: 'There is no servant upon whom the bounties of Allah have become manifest, except that the provision/cost of the people upon him intensifies. So whoever does not attend to the needs of the people, he has exposed the bounty to perishing.' He said: 'I said: May I be your ransom, and who has the ability to attend to the needs of this creation?' He said: 'Rather, the people in this regard, by Allah, are the believers.'
ai.seo_question: What is the spiritual consequence of failing to meet the needs of people when blessed with abundance?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the principle of *Zawāl al-Ni‘mah* (vanishing of blessings), linking material prosperity directly to social accountability. He clarifies that the primary agents responsible for sustaining the community's welfare are the *al-Mu’minūn* (the believers), thereby elevating their role from passive recipients of grace to active stewards of divine favor.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from Ali Bin Muhammad Al Qasany, from Abu Ayoub Al Madany, a slave of the Clan of Hashimas, from Dawood Bin Abdullah Bin Muhammad Al Ja’fary, from Ibrahim Bin Muhammad who said,

‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> There is none from a Believer upon whom the Bounties of Allah<sup>azwj</sup> are Manifested except that he should intensify the provision of the people upon it. So the one who does not stand for the people with their needs, so he has declined the Bounties (which were on its way to him)’. So I said, ‘May I be sacrificed for you<sup>asws</sup>! And who has the ability that he would stand for these people with their needs?’ So he<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘But rather, the people in this subject matter, by Allah<sup>azwj</sup>, are the Believers’.
en.sarwar: 2. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from Ali ibn Muhammad al-Qasaniy from abu Ayyub al-Madaniy, Mawla banu Hashim from Dawud ibn ‘Abd Allah ibn Muhammad al-Ja’fariy from Ibrahim ibn Muhammad who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘Whoever finds himself with an abundance of Allah’s bounties, increases his spending for people. One who does not help people exposes the bounties to losses.’ I (the narrator) said, ‘I pray to Allah to keep my soul in service for your cause. Who can spend to help all these creatures?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘The people there, by Allah, are the believing people.’”
